title: Tandag City suspends in-person classes due to heavy rains

blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — The local government of Tandag City, Surigao del Sur, suspended face-to-face classes across all levels in both public and private schools on Tuesday due to heavy downpours that triggered flooding in parts of the city. Mayor Roxanne Pimentel declared the suspension effective immediately and “until lifted,” citing weather forecasts
